translations.web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
translations.bsb: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
translations.kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
translations.asv: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
